item.title: Jul 2 - Questions I'm exploring
item.description: Will context windows really not get that large? What is driving that improvement in sample efficiency? Better training distribution, larger models, longer context lets you feed in more examples.

item.title: Jul 7 - Questions I'm exploring
item.description: What is the relationship between interaction models and next action prediction? Is there an economic incentive to be pulled out of the loop (turned into a value consumer) versus remaining in the loop (turned into a value producer)? .

item.title: AI Alignment Schools of Thought
item.description: It seems to be that there are two major schools of thought for AI alignment work: AI as a tool AI as a self but having completely internalized human values Fundamentally, LLMs are predictors and they will inevitably have some kind of self-prediction.
